executable.question: how many customers in Denver?
executable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop.customers WHERE city = 'Denver'

executable.question: how many customers in miami
executable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop.customers WHERE city = 'Miami'

executable.question: How many orders were returned?
executable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop.orders WHERE status = 'returned'

executable.question: how many orders are placed
executable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop.orders WHERE status = 'placed'

executable.question: top 3 products by revenue
executable.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM shop.products p JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, p.id LIMIT 3

executable.question: top 10 products by revenue?
executable.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM shop.products p JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, p.id LIMIT 10

executable.question: revenue by category
executable.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM shop.products p JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

executable.question: Revenue by category?

executable.question: orders per month in 2025
executable.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM shop.orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
